policy: Records remote/small-island ports whose local public onward access has been reviewed. Use no_scheduled_public_bus only when the island has no ordinary scheduled public bus route suitable for gameplay; tourist-only, hotel shuttle, rental vehicle, bicycle, taxi-only, and demand/on-call services are not promoted as playable scheduled bus.

notes: 竹富町観光協会 describes Hatoma island local movement as walking or rental bicycle and does not list route-bus service.
Iriomote Tour states Hatoma has no bus or taxi; it recommends walking or rental bicycle.
竹富町観光協会 lists rental bicycle, rental motorcycle, and rental car for Kuroshima local movement, not route bus.
Skyticket's Kuroshima terminal guide says Kuroshima has no fixed-timetable route bus.
竹富町観光協会 lists rental bicycle, rental car, and rental motorcycle for Hateruma local movement, not route bus.
Oki-raku and Skyticket travel guides both state Hateruma has no route bus/taxi and visitors use rental vehicles or walking.
MLIT smart-island survey material for Sakushima says the island currently has no bus or taxi; it discusses alternative personal-mobility experiments.
Hiroshima city route-improvement material states Ninoshima has no route bus or taxi public transport on the island.
The operator's island map is a walking/spot guide and does not publish a scheduled island bus route.
Official Urato Islands pages describe municipal ferry access, island-to-island call-up boats, and walking model courses.
The call-up island boat is not an ordinary scheduled bus and should stay in the ship/walk layer, not be promoted as playable bus.
Chugoku transport bureau material lists Sagoshima's island transport as none.
No scheduled public bus is available to ingest for gameplay.
Meon ferry tourism page states Ogijima has no bus and walking is the main way to move around.
Takamatsu route-improvement material says no public transport operates on Ogijima.
PICA Hatsushima and Hatsushima cooperative pages describe local movement as walking around the compact island.
Atami sightseeing material states Hatsushima has no taxi or route bus.
Chugoku transport bureau material for the Tomo-Hashirijima route lists Hashirijima island transport as none.
No scheduled island bus is available to ingest for gameplay.
Travelroad and Niijima Kogyosho local guide pages state Toshima has no route bus or taxi; movement is essentially walking.
Rental car/bicycle is also not available, so there is no scheduled public bus dataset to collect.
Ogasawara Hahajima tourism material states Hahajima has no bus or taxi.
Paid local transport is not an ordinary scheduled bus and is not promoted as playable bus.
Local travel guides state Kohamajima has no route bus or taxi; movement is by rental vehicle, bicycle, hotel shuttle, or reserved sightseeing bus.
The available Kohama Kotsu bus is a reserved sightseeing bus tour, not an ordinary scheduled public bus suitable for gameplay ingestion.
Travelroad states Shikinejima has no route bus or taxi service.
Shikinejima Magazine likewise describes the small island as having no bus or taxi; local movement is walking or rental vehicle.

notes: Chugoku transport bureau material for the Kasaoka-Tobishima-Mushima remote-island route lists island transport as none.
Kasaoka tourism pages describe island access by regular passenger ship and walking, not scheduled local bus.
Kagawa tourism official page says movement on Awashima is on foot; rental bicycle is recommended for the northern area.
The linked community bus access is for reaching the mainland ferry port, not an ordinary scheduled bus operating on Awashima itself.
